_about: Revision 1 of the subway-station-coords dataset: each served station's camera point, the mean of its lines' platform points in the Seoul Open Data station master (subwayStationMaster/1/1000, fields BLDN_NM, ROUTE, LAT, LOT, WGS84), captured 2026-10-23: Sungkyunkwan Univ. on the Gyeongbu line; Hyehwa on line 4; Jeongja on the Bundang and Shinbundang lines; Jamsil on lines 2 and 8; Dogok on line 3 and the Bundang line; Gangnam on line 2 and the Shinbundang line; Yangjae on line 3 and the Shinbundang line; Gwanggyojungang on the Shinbundang extension. Means rounded to six decimals, keyed by station slug in SUBWAY_STATIONS order. Not trimmed. Revision 2 (2026-10-25) adds 사당 (lines 2 and 4), 금정 (경부선 and 과천선 rows) and 종로5가 (line 1), from the same master captured 2026-10-25.
